items.prompt_en: 16:9 pixel-art illustration, night laboratory with fluorescent-microscope color accents on a dark navy background (#13141f). Three chunky server cabinets stand in a row with small status lights: the first glows green, the second blue, the third amber. In front of them, four chibi lab characters: a confident scientist with thin teal rectangular glasses, black hair with one white streak and a short ponytail, white lab coat over black vest and tie, gesturing toward the cabinets; a female assistant with long pink hair in two round buns and a navy streak, white lab coat over a lavender hoodie, jeans, holding a paper note; a small fruit-fly researcher with red compound eyes, blue helmet with a gold stripe and pink and blue wires, white coat over black vest, holding a clipboard; a beige box-shaped retro CRT computer robot with a dark green screen showing mint pixel eyes and mouth, a short antenna tipped with an abacus bead, grey segmented arms, two caterpillar tracks, holding a wooden abacus. Height order: scientist tallest, assistant slightly shorter, robot shorter, fruit fly smallest. Leave the upper-left third empty for a title. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
